jobs.title: VP, Information Technology | QSR
jobs.description:
A fast growing QSR organization is looking for a VP of Information Technology
to lead technology strategy and execution as the business continues to scale.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who understands the pace and complexity of quick service restaurants, multi unit operations, and high growth environments
. You will be responsible for building and evolving the technology infrastructure that supports restaurant operations, corporate teams, and continued expansion.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the overall IT strategy and technology roadmap across the organization
• Partner closely with Operations and executive leadership to make sure technology supports business growth
• Oversee systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, networks, and technology platforms
• Lead technology initiatives supporting new locations, expansion, and operational growth
• Evaluate and implement systems that improve restaurant efficiency, speed, reporting, and the guest experience
• Manage technology vendors, partners, budgets, and major implementations
• Build, lead, and develop a high performing IT team
• Ensure systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and capable of supporting continued growth
• Drive digital and technology initiatives across the restaurant organization

What We’re Looking For

• VP, SVP, or senior IT leadership experience

• Required: QSR or large scale restaurant technology experience

• Proven experience supporting a multi unit organization

• Experience leading IT in a fast growing or rapidly scaling business

• Strong understanding of restaurant technology, including POS, digital ordering, infrastructure, networks, and enterprise systems
• Experience managing technology teams, vendors, budgets, and large scale implementations
• Strong business partnership skills with the ability to work closely with Operations and executive leadership
• Experience building scalable technology infrastructure for continued growth
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity, data protection, and technology risk
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 annually
, based on experience.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of technology for a growing QSR organization and play a key role in building the systems and infrastructure needed for its next stage of growth.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, IT TMT M&A - Due Diligence, Integration and Separation – Strategy to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities:

Manage and oversee comprehensive Buy-Side and Sell-Side assessments across critical IT domains for potential client acquisitions, with a focus on technology platforms, media content delivery networks, and telecommunications infrastructure; identify key IT risks, opportunities, and investments needed, and deliver executive-level due diligence reports with strategic recommendations
Direct IT integration and separation initiatives from planning through execution for TMT-related transactions, including software/SaaS, digital media, and telecom services; oversee development of IT current state assessments, entanglement identification, operating model definitions, synergies, and Day 1 and post-close plans and lead execution engagements including the implementation of ERP, HRIS, CRM, Microsoft 365 and other business applications platforms
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Technology M&A offerings focused on software, digital media, telecom, platform modernization, and ecosystem integration; provide thought leadership on TMT architectures, including cloud-native platforms, SaaS, content delivery networks (CDNs), and 5G/telecom infrastructure
Establish and manage program governance frameworks, ensuring rigorous oversight of execution across complex, multi-vendor TMT environments; lead development of governance work products including status reporting, risk management, and issue tracking; implement AI-powered tools for predictive analytics on project timelines and risks and collaborate with senior cross-functional teams to identify technology dependencies, risks, and opportunities across technology operations, product, engineering, and content/broadcast operations
Lead strategic discussions and presentations with executive IT and business stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, Chief Product Officers, and leaders in engineering and content
Lead efforts to mentor and develop junior staff, fostering deep TMT expertise and delivery excellence across the team

Qualifications:

Minimum eight years of recent experience in technology/business consulting and/or technology leadership, with a proven track record of leading IT transformations and advising on complex M&A transactions
Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, finance, or a related field from an accredited college/university required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is preferred
Demonstrated success in leading high-impact IT-focused M&A projects with expertise in at least three of the following: system integration/separation, cloud platform migration, digital media workflow optimization, telecom network integration, or IT architecture modernization; advanced program management skills, with the capacity to oversee large, complex projects and deliver strategic insights to executive audiences; familiarity with leveraging AI-powered platforms for due diligence, synergy analysis, and integration planning is a significant plus

Comprehensive understanding of IT best practices and enterprise IT ecosystems, including major ERP, CRM, HRIS, and other business application platforms, IT solutions, systems, infrastructure, and cybersecurity; experience in the selection and implementation of Tier 1 or 2 service-centric ERP systems with broad knowledge across core finance modules supporting Order to Cash required; knowledge of supply chain and product-centric functionality helpful but not required
Strong strategic thinking and leadership abilities with experience developing and executing IT strategies that align with business objectives; experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies and driving business growth in the M&A space, including client relationship management and engagement in business development activities; proven ability to lead and mentor cross-functional teams
Willingness and ability to travel as needed to serve client needs

jobs.description:
Technology Strategy Principal Director -- Insurance Industry

We Are:

Technology Strategy and Advisory and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors
in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to architect and realize exceptional value
from technology for our clients.

Technology Strategy leverages deep technology expertise, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that develop pioneering, technology-enabled strategies that unlock value and drive growth. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must build new business architectures that break away from old ways of doing things, giving them the agility to compete and grow in the new. Accenture Technology Strategy enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we develop new capabilities in areas including Applied Intelligence, data and analytics, blockchain, robotics, Internet of Things and cyber

You Are:

A Technology Strategy Thought Leader & Expert with tons of top-flight leadership experience in technology and management skills, with embedded relationships and experience in the Financial Services Banking sector. You have deep, differentiated skills and expertise that are in high demand and relevant in the market. You have energy and drive in abundance, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. As a senior leader, you’re a natural at appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams, while also establishing credibility & confidence with C-Suite client leaders. As a Principal Director, you demonstrate “the four Cs” to the fullest:

Credentials – you have a proven track record of consistently delivering high value work.

Capability – you can show meaningful contribution to assets and practice areas.

Connections – you have evidence of C-Suite relevance and demonstrated ability to build senior client relationships.

Content – you have demonstrated ability to contribute, build, and lead thought capital.

The Work:

Lead complex projects to make sure clients are positioned for long-term success with practical road maps for carrying out Digital, IT or Cloud strategy, managing change, monitoring and gauging processes, and taking remedial steps.

Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology, and operations.

Build relationships with clients to raise Accenture’s profile as a long-term trusted advisor and partner

Strengthen Accenture’s Technology Strategy practice and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.

Drive and lead projects that deliver world-class business technology strategy solutions.

Mentor junior members of the Strategy team and prepare them for more responsibility. economic, technology, and social trends.

Travel as needed.

Here is what you need:

Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in Technology Strategy, including at least 8 years in a management or leadership role driving technology-led business transformation within the Financial Services/Banking Industry.

Minimum of 8 years of experience in management or strategy consulting, with a proven track record of shaping and delivering complex technology strategy engagements for C-suite clients Including deep expertise in at least two of the following Technology Strategy domains:

Operating Model Design & Technology Architecture Strategy

Technology M&A / Post-Merger Integration Strategy

Technology Value Realization and Cost Take-Out

Cloud, Data, or AI-Enabled Transformation Strategy

Technology-Driven Revenue Growth or Platform Modernization

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Bonus Points If:

You have a proven ability to lead high-performing teams, structure complex problem-solving efforts, and translate business strategy into actionable technology initiatives.

Demonstrated experience developing and presenting business cases (both quantitative and qualitative) to support major strategic initiatives or technology investments.

Recognized as a Thought Leader or Subject Matter Expert in Technology Strategy for Financial Services — evidenced by one or more of the following:

Publishing thought leadership or research papers

Speaking at industry conferences or client forums

Serving as a recognized internal or external SME for Technology Strategy topics

You bring a strong network and reputation within the Financial Services ecosystem and can open doors to new client relationships.

You have experience developing go-to-market assets or intellectual capital in Technology Strategy.

You have demonstrated commercial acumen — managing budgets, forecasts, and complex deal structures.

You are known for building trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders and advising senior executives on technology-enabled growth and efficiency opportunities.

You have advanced communication and presentation skills, with a history of delivering compelling, executive-level narratives.

You are passionate about coaching and developing junior practitioners, helping shape the next generation of Technology Strategy leaders.

new_jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services - all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Over 500,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

You Are:

A tolling technology professional with strong program leadership capabilities and experience delivering complex electronic toll collection, back-office modernization, roadside systems, customer service operations technology, and interoperability initiatives. You understand the technical and operational environment of tolling agencies and infrastructure operators and can translate business and technology requirements into executable delivery plans. You are comfortable leading multidisciplinary engineering and consulting teams, managing client stakeholders across technology and operations, establishing governance, resolving delivery challenges, and driving measurable outcomes. You bring deep tolling technology knowledge, operational discipline, sound judgment, financial awareness, and a collaborative leadership style that helps teams perform at their best.

The Work:

Lead delivery of tolling technology modernization programs — including back-office platform implementations, MLFF/AET roadside deployments, customer service operations technology, and interoperability integrations — from planning through implementation and operational transition.

Manage program governance, scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, quality, forecasting, and executive reporting.

Lead and support technology modernization initiatives spanning tolling back-office systems (CSC, violations, collections), customer service operations technology (contact center platforms, CRM, self-service digital channels, omnichannel engagement), roadside and MLFF systems, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, data analytics, and AI/ML-enabled tolling operations.

Lead cross-functional teams spanning systems architecture, software engineering, systems integration, operations, customer service technology, data and analytics, and organizational change management.

Develop tolling technology delivery plans, system integration roadmaps, business cases, technical operating models, functional and non-functional requirements, and phased implementation strategies.

Partner with tolling agency and private-sector technology stakeholders to identify operational and technology improvement opportunities and translate them into sustainable, scalable delivery outcomes across tolling and customer service platforms.

Support strategic pursuits, proposals, solutioning, estimates, staffing plans, presentations, and oral defenses.

Contribute to Smart Mobility Hub tolling technology offerings, reusable assets, reference architectures, credentials, accelerators, and thought leadership across tolling back-office, roadside, and customer service operations technology domains.

Coach consultants and managers, strengthen delivery capability, and promote consistent project management and quality practices.

Use data and forward-looking performance indicators to improve decision-making, accountability, and delivery predictability.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requiremen t

Here's What You Need:

A minimum of 8 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, back-office or roadside systems, customer service operations technology, transportation systems integration, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

A minimum of 5 years of experience leading tolling technology programs, systems integration projects, PMOs, delivery workstreams, or technology modernization initiatives in a tolling or transportation context.

Experience managing client stakeholders, cross-functional teams, budgets, schedules, risks, quality, and delivery reporting.

Experience with at least one of the following: tolling back-office platforms, electronic toll collection technology, customer service operations technology (contact centers, CRM, self-service), MLFF/AET roadside systems, interoperability frameworks, violations and collections systems, or revenue assurance platforms.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

Bonus Points If:

You have hands-on experience with electronic toll collection technology, customer account management platforms, billing, violations processing, enforcement workflows, interoperability protocols (e.g., E-ZPass, ETAN), contact center or CRM systems, self-service digital channels, or revenue assurance platforms.

You have experience supporting tolling authorities, transportation agencies, state departments of transportation, concessionaires, or public-private partnerships.

You have experience with design-build, field deployment, testing, commissioning, acceptance, or complex system integration.

You have experience applying Power BI, predictive analytics, AI/ML-enabled tools, computer vision, cloud-native platforms, or AI-powered service automation to improve tolling technology delivery, customer service operations, or revenue performance.

You have experience with Agile, SAFe, ERP modernization, PMO transformation, or enterprise change initiatives.

You have PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or other relevant professional certification.

You have participated in IBTTA, ITS America, AASHTO, or related transportation industry organizations.
